integrity: Proved by a causal witness and a local induction; two standalone programs corroborate finite cases. Literature priority may be incomplete; no external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to three-state synchronous threshold-b excitation on complete rooted b-ary trees with b at least two. It does not count nonmaximal extinction shells, and does not apply to incomplete trees, other thresholds, or more states.
title: Exact terminal-wave rarity on complete branching trees
